messages:
Aisha Malik: FYI saw a failure when a quarantined project hit /operator/status. Exchange returned 403 'project_quarantine'. Anyone seen this pattern?
Noah Park: that should've been short-circuited by the router. Can you dump headers?
Aisha Malik: sanitized headers: `X-Project-ID: proj-412`, `Authorization: Bearer <redacted>`, `X-Quarantine: true`
Ruth Gomez: router enforces quarantine and denies delegation. But /operator/status is read-only and we probably want to allow it. We debated endpoint-level overrides but avoided them in the RFC.
Noah Park: proposal: add `quarantine_mode` in project metadata (strict|permissive|shielded) + route-level `quarantine_override: allow` for specific read-only endpoints.
Aisha Malik: agree. Important: cache keys must incorporate quarantine_mode to avoid reusing impersonation tokens across projects. e.g. `cache-key = model|project|quarantine_mode`.
Ruth Gomez: also require audit for any override. For permissive mode, still block delegation but allow explicit list of safe endpoints.
ops-bot: alert: 2026-03-21T16:03:12Z blocked delegation proj-412 -> operator (403 project_quarantine)
Noah Park: next steps: Ruth prototypes router override and cache-key change; I'll update the RFC compatibility matrix and migration (map old flag -> strict). Also add runtime emergency toggle for Dedicated.
Aisha Malik: I'll mute the noisy alert for /operator/status until we roll a fix.
Ruth Gomez: ETA prototype 10 days, will post perf and test results here.
Aisha Malik: thanks, tagging eng-platform and eng-security for owners.
